bug.summary: Auto-scroll targets the wrong row: ranks repeat across countries, so when the now-playing track's country differs from the browsed country, scrolling by rank lands on an unrelated row. Needs a guard that scrolls only when the playing country is the one on screen.

source: Motivated epic #185: the pre-#185 agent returned No findings here while the code-review skill confirmed the bug. Fixed within the PR at 96755ec (fix commit title: 'scroll only when the playing country is the one on screen').

bug.summary: Coverage percentage divides by the changed-file count without guarding total==0, so a PR with zero changed files raises ZeroDivisionError instead of returning a label.
Reply blob link is built from the base repo owner/name, but head_sha lives in the fork on a cross-repo PR, so the generated base-repo blob URL 404s.

The ack is posted with `gh api -f body=@-`, but -f/--raw-field sends values verbatim, so the literal two-char string @- is posted as the comment body instead of the piped stdin content (needs -F/--input -).

A second `trap ... EXIT` for post_err cleanup replaces the earlier `rm -rf $SCRATCH` EXIT trap rather than adding to it (bash traps are not additive), so every reply run leaks its scratch clone under TMPDIR.

EXISTING_PENDING_REVIEW_ID picks the first viewer PENDING review with no discriminator, so on others' PRs the reply path deletes the Finding-bearing draft review (which stays PENDING as the ADR 0008 safety gate) instead of only a stale reply wrapper.

If headRepositoryOwner.login or headRepository.name is null (closed PR with deleted fork/user), jq's null-plus-slash concat fails and the command substitution silently yields empty string, which the */-style guard does not catch, so execution falls through into gh repo clone with an empty repo.

The per-cycle outcome marker is keyed only on repo_name-pr_number, omitting owner, so two watched repos sharing a name under different owners (orgA/api, orgB/api) collide on api-5 and the second dispatch overwrites the first, miscounting the end-of-cycle tally.

The multi-lens wait loop exits 1 the moment one lens times out or returns empty, without reaping or killing the other already-launched lens PIDs; since 5 lenses share a 3-slot pool the later-dispatched lenses are still inside their own timeout budget, so a normal early timeout aborts the whole review and orphans running children.

armAudio's finally unconditionally restores the prime element's captured src; on iOS where context.resume() is deferred, toggle can assign a real previewUrl mid-arm, and the stale restore then overwrites it back to the silent clip, leaving playback silent. Fix guards the restore with if (element.src === SILENT_WAV).

The drag handler binds onUp only to pointerup, not pointercancel; when a touch is interrupted the capture releases and no pointerup fires, so onUp never runs, g.dragging stays true and sim.mode stays drag, freezing the globe.

generateMetadata defines an openGraph object without type: website; Next.js merges metadata shallowly at the top level, so this openGraph replaces the layout's entirely and the layout's sole type: website declaration drops from the rendered og:type.

Validation drops invalid keys but preserves them in the store as commentary: null; computeWorklist skips any present key (if key in input.commentary continue), so a preserved-but-invalid entry blocks its own regeneration and the store never converges back to valid.

runAllCountries uploads to the live pathname charts/v1/charts.json with neither uploadPrevious nor fetchPrevious wired in, so a local crawl overwrites the outgoing charts without snapshotting them into charts-prev.json, leaving prev stale while commentary:todo still reports live movement triggers.
